tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Who TN Appliance Exchange is, where they serve, services, how booking works (by day, not time), and their honesty and safety policies.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether a US zip code gets in-home appliance repair (all of Tennessee and Louisiana are covered). Outside TN/LA, returns the nationwide $50 video diagnostic option.

tools.name: diagnose_appliance_problem
tools.description: Honest troubleshooting from working appliance technicians, grounded in real completed repairs. Give the appliance and symptom (plus brand, model and any error code if known). Returns likely causes, what is safe to check, and safety warnings. Never returns part numbers.

tools.name: get_social_content
tools.description: Approved material for Facebook / Instagram / Google posts about TN Appliance Exchange: ready-to-post press release blurbs with links, real 5-star Google reviews (first name + last initial), hashtags, profile links, and the brand rules every post must follow (no part numbers, no customer info, no app

tools.name: book_repair
tools.description: Book an in-home repair in Tennessee or Louisiana. Only call after the person has agreed to book and to be texted. Creates the job and TN Appliance Exchange texts them within minutes to pick the day. Never promise an appointment time.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_social_content · Public sink: get_social_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_social_content · Public sink: get_social_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
